title: Create usePlayback React hook wrapping all strategies
acceptance_criteria: Creates strategy instance via useMemo with switch(getPlatform()) — Desktop/iOS/Android
Strategy instance never changes after mount (stable reference)
Single useEffect owns ALL audio event listeners: timeupdate, loadedmetadata, ended, waiting, playing, pause, error
Exports: { gesturePlay, nonGesturePlay, togglePlay, seek, currentTime, duration, isPlayPending, onEndedRef }
togglePlay() pauses if playing, plays if paused with isPlayPending guard
onEndedRef pattern delegates ended handling to PlayerBar
Strategy cleanup on unmount via destroy()
completion_summary: Created client/src/playback/usePlayback.ts -- central hook wrapping all strategies + owning audio event listeners
